source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
I have now created the assembly. However, some dimensions have not been provided, several others are inconsistent, and the intended installation locations for the two separate parts are still not entirely clear.
I have compiled a list of questions requiring clarification and am awaiting your responses. Once I receive them, I will revise the model and provide a sectional view of the assembly using the dimensions available at that point. Additional corrections might still be necessary afterward.
I look forward to receiving your feedback.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports creating an initial shaft assembly model while noting that missing and inconsistent dimensions require later revision.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I am uncertain whether I can obtain photos of the machine. However, a 3D file is always appreciated.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: In general, I believe the model is essentially finished. As noted previously, the only remaining issue I do not understand is the way the bushing must be secured. What file format would you prefer?

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that the 3D model is essentially finished, apart from the unresolved bushing-retention configuration.
